fields.description: Ten-minute Bento is a bento cook-book in English written by Megumi Fujii. This book presents about 30 complete and simple bento boxes that can be thrown together in 10 minutes or less. An ideal book for busy people who want to make bento quick and easy in the morning.  It's paperback and printed in full color with lots of photographs of the finished dishes and serving ideas. You can also find some handy tips, such as adding lemon to avocado keeps it from oxidizing. It is an inspiring and intelligent cook-book. First published in Japanese in 2007, translated to English in 2012.  Printed in the USA Dimensions: 25cm high, 18cm wide (9.84 x 7.08) 80 pages

fields.description: This product is out of stock at the moment, we will be getting new stock in December or early January. Please click on the red button that says Notify me when available to get notified of when it comes in.  Sorry for the inconvenience. Bento&coWe are glad to present the new generation of bento boxes : Atsuben Kun, the first bento with a hot plate included !There is no need to wait for the winter to enjoy this fantastic box ! A hot lunch everyday is so much better than a cold and flavorless one isn't it ? DescriptionAtsuben Kun, looks like a regular  box. This 2-tier white box contains more than that, as it will change the way you see bento boxes ! The made in Japan  technology is here for you !The lower container has a hot plate included. You just need to plug the Atsuben Ken to heat up your bento.  You can choose between the mains-powered adapter or the cigar lighter adapter.This amazing feat uses a high quality technology : this company makes also military heated jacket !Your food will not be just kept warm, as isothermal bags do. The Atsuben Kun really heat your meal. Further info bellow, after the video. The box  is sold with its adaptor. This box can be used as much at 100 volt (like in Japan) as at 120 volt (USA) or 220 volt  !For the moment, the box is only available in white. The black version will come soon (september 2011).How does it works ?Plug your Astuben Kun. Allow 70 minutes to get a reasonable temperature to eat a hot steaming lunch. You may start to use it around 11 o'clock if you want it to be ready at lunch time.The hot plate is located in the lower container, so this is where you should put the food you want to be the hottest. The adaptor is from 100V to 220V 50-60Hz. Output : DC8V 3 Amp. Made in Japan, it's a flat plug adaptor (suitable for US or Japan). You can find cheap adaptor for your type of plug (ask us if you need more info). You can also plug it on a cigar lighter adaptor in your car or on a lithium battery. Wherever you go, you'll always have a hot bento (nice slogan!)FeaturesConsists in two containers Total Capacity : 580 ml. Dimensions : 160 00d7 100 00d7 90 mm. (6,3 x 3,9 x 3,5) Weight : 520 g. You may need a 24cm carrying elastic band and a adaptor (sold separately on this page). Upper tier220 mlPolypropyleneWith an hermetic lidLower tier    360 mlPolypropyleneHot plate Polycarbonate  CareThe 2 containers are dishwasher safe. Wash and dry before use. Do not put directly food or water on the hot plate.  Made in Japan.
fields.name: Atsuben Kun

fields.description: The great thing about Japanese bento boxes is that they aren't limited to traditional shapes. The Bagel Lunch Box is a great example of a box designed for a specific purpose - carrying bagels! The Bagel Lunch Box is available in 2 colors: Ivory and Pink. Please choose your favorite from the pulldown menu when ordering.Size S.Product DescriptionThe Bagel Lunch Box is a practical, compact box with two compartments. One is designed for carrying a bagel or a large round roll, such as a kaiser roll or hamburger bun, while the smaller compartment, which has a leakproof lid of its own, can hold a small side salad or fruit. You could also carry your bagel, roll or even a mini-pita or two separately from the fillings, and put them together at lunchtime. The outer lid clips on securely, and can double as a soup or salad bowl at lunchtime. FeaturesTotal capacity of box when closed: 325 ml (the upper compartment can hold 225 ml). Capacity of the lid/bowl is 310ml. Dimensions : 127 mm (5) diameter; 136 mm (5.35) maximum width with the clips; 82 mm (3.23) high.  Included an illustrated recipe booklet in Japanese. Composition and care The box, inner compartment and outer lid are made of polypropelene (maximum temperature: 14000b0C or 28400b0F). The inner compartment lid is made of polyethelene (maximum temperature: 6000b0C or 14000b0F). The box can be microwaved for up to 2 minutes at 700 watts or put in the dishwasher, with the inner and outer lids removed. Handwashing is recommended  especially for the inner lid. Caution: The inner compartment is leak-resistant, but not leakproof, so don't fill it something too liquid. Made in Japan.
fields.name: Bagel Lunch Box

fields.description: A balan or baran is a small piece of plastic film or other material that are used in a bento box to keep certain foods separate from each other, to prop up wobbly foods, or just to add a splash of color. You may be familiar with balan already as 'sushi grass' in takeout sushi boxes. Balan Animal consists of 2 packets of adorable animal shaped balan, in 8 different designs including a panda, pig, monkey and bear - for a total of 16 balan. They are perfect for decorating a bento box, or for keeping the flavors of different foods from mingling. Balan Animal balans are microwave safe (maximum 600W for 3 minutes) so you can heat up your bento box! With care, these balan can be washed and re-used several times. Made in Japan.

And three interchangeable blades :  - thin blade for very thin juliennes from 0,3mm  2mm (adjusting the level) - medium blade for juliennes from 0,3mm to 3mm (idem) - coarse blade for juliennes from 0,3mm to 4mm (idem) To attach the blades, turn the screws on both sides of the mandoline.Dimensions : 31,5cm long (12.40) and 9,2cm wide (3.6), the cutting surface is 6,4cm wide (2.51).2. Benriner SUPER, 3 blades, 3.75 wide, white.Longer and wider than the classic one, Benriner Super has the same blades (see above for more information). Dimensions : 34 cm long (13.38) and 13 cm wide (5.11). the cutting surface is 9,5cm wide (3.74).3. Benriner JUMBO, 1 blade, 4.72 wide, green.The widest of the collection.  If you just need a big slicer for your big veggies (radish, cabbage, onion...), the Jumbo one is perfect.  Dimensions : 30,5 cm long (12) and 14,5 cm wide (4.72). the cutting surface is 12cm wide (4.72).The blade allows you to make slices from 0.2mm to 8mm thick. Just turn the screw beneath the mandoline clock-wise for thin slices and counter clock-wise for thicker slices.Features : A finger safety guard is also included.  With a vintage look, this cooking ustensile will remain one of your favorite in your kitchen for years. Each blade is very sharp. Don't let a child play with it. Material : stainless steel blades, mandoline made of plastic, BPA free. Care : hand-washing is recommended. Made in Japan*Benri means practical in japanese. Beriner could be translated as Mr Practical!

With a lots of details, those three pieces are very good quality cutters. The big Dragon is about 10cm long (3.9) and 5cm wide (1.9).The small Dragon is about 4,2cm long (1.6) and 2,2cm wide (0.8).  (In case you don't know, 2012 is year of the Dragon !)The Phoenix is about 4.5cm long (1.77) and 2,2cm wide (0.86)You can use it for cutting fruits, piece of cheese or to make pretty cookies !Made in Japan, stainless steel. The shape in welded manually on a large base which can be hold easily. Cost explanation :     - Those products are handmade by Japanese craftsmen. The shape of the animal is formed on a long steel plaque with little pliers. Each piece requires several very skilled artisans to complete that makes it unique.     -Food cutters like these ones are mainly to prepare food  in a professional setting, whether working as a cook, pastry chef or baker. It's quite rare to find such cutters in non-professional shops. We're glad to be able to share them with our customers.    -Bestiary cutter should last for lifetime and more, they won't let you down !
fields.name: Bestiary cutters

fields.description: We love the Bin 8, a great example of clever and attractive Japanese design. It looks like an attractive bottle, but it actually contains 8 essential kitchen tools in one!From the top of the bottle going down, the Bin 8 consists of: A funnel with attachment, for pouring sauces and liquids into containers. The attachment makes it possible to fill even narrow neck bottles, and also forms the cap of the 'bottle' when stacked together. A lemon juicerA spice grater, for grating fresh ginger for exampleAn egg masher, for making egg salad in a jiffyA cheese grater, to add a sprinkle of fresh Parmesan on your pastaA lid grip/opener, for those stubborn jar lidsAn egg yolk separator And a measuring cup that measures up to 420mlAll the parts stack together to look like a wine bottle. You can leave it out on your countertop where it will look great! Handwashing is recommended. The manufacturer recommends giving it a rinse before using it for the first time. Made in Japan.
fields.name: Bin 8

fields.description: The Block Bento appeals to the kid in all of us. Who didn't grow up playing with plastic building blocks? The Block Bento is available in 5 bright primary colors: Blue, Red, White, Black and barbie Pink (!). Please choose your favorite from the pulldown menu when ordering. Size S. Presentation The Block Bento is no toy - it's a practical, two-tier bento box. The size is perfect for kids and adults with small appetites. Each tier has its own flexible, leak-resistant lid. A pair of chopsticks is included, which fits neatly into a special slot on top of one of the inner lids (in the blue one and red one, an ice-pack is also included). And yes, the blocks do stack together. Buy two or more of these boxes to mix and match the colors! The boxes are white on the inside, and colored on the outside. The flexible inner lids are white, as are the chopsticks. An elastic bento belt in a matching color is included. Features Total capacity: 480ml (240ml each compartment).Dimensions: 155 00d7 75 00d7 80 mm (6.1 x 3 x 3.2). The chopsticks are 15cm (5.9) long. Composition and Care The box is made of PET-PBT. The flexible inner lids are made of polyurethene. The chopsticks are plastic PS. The box is microwave and dishwasher safe with the inner lids removed. Handwash the inner lids and the chopsticks. Do not place in the oven or near an open flame.Made in Japan.
fields.name: Block Bento

fields.description: Here come, at last, the matching chopsticks of our Block Bento to complete your collection. These 23cm long (9) Block chopsticks are available in 3 colors : blue, pink and red. They have a gripping end, to grab food easier.   Made of plastic AS, so dishwasher safe. And of course, they interlock with each other like the famous bricks !Made in China.
fields.name: Block Hashi

fields.description: The Cafe Lunch Plate is an ultra-pratical set to bring everywhere you go. A three compartment box-plate and an elegant My cutlery set in just one box, so you won't regret anymore to forget your cutlery again...Size S/MProduct DescriptionCafe Lunch Plate consists in one three-compartment plate : the main space in the center is for your main dish and two little compartments for side dishes or deserts. The cutlery set fits in the inner lid : the set consists of two tapered handles that can be inserted into the ends of a pair of chopsticks, or a rounded fork and spoon. The business ends of the utensils are all in black (or white for 3 new colors), and the handles and box are in the color indicated.The outer lid is decorated with a modern pattern of flowers and leaves. A small 3 recipes guide comes with the box, everything is in japanese, but the pictures are much more significant. Cafe Lunch Plate is available in 3 colors: Brown and Green (the pink one is no longer available). Please select your favorite from the pulldown menu when ordering.Check on this Bento Blog to see how you can fill this box! Features Total capacity: 500 ml  Measurements: 214 00d7 123 00d7 56 mm (8,4 x 4,8 x 2,2). The chopsticks are 21.5 cm (8.5) long when assembled.  The fork and spoon are 16.2 cm (6.4) long when assembled. Sold with a lunch Band strap.Composition and Care The bento box and outer lid are made of polyprylene. The inner lids are made of polyethylene (safe temperature range: -2000b0C to 6000b0C (-400b0F to 14000b0F). The utensils are made of ABS, with a maximum safe temperature of 7000b0C (15800b0F). The whole set should be handwashed.The box is  microwave safe with the inner and outer lids removed. Keep away from high heat.Do not place in the oven or near an open flame.Made in Japan
fields.name: Cafe Lunch Plate

fields.description: Are you a Canon fan or a Nikon afficionado? Both camps will love these amazingly detailed Camera Lens Mugs. They are practical thermal beverage mugs that look like expensive camera lenses! You have the choice between a mug that is a replica of a Canon 24-105mm lens, a Canon White Macro 100mm or a Nikon 24-70mm f2.8.. Remarkably realistic and down to the finest detail this is a great gift for the serious camera buff in your life. 1) The Canon 24-105 mug  has a capacity of 300 ml (a bit more than 1 cup) and is 12 cm (4.7) tall. It comes with a lens-cap lid.2) The Nikon 24-70mm 2.8 has a capacity of 400 ml (a bit more than 1 cup) and is 16 cm (6.3) tall. It comes with a lens-cap lid.3) The Canon White 100mm 2.8 has a capacity of 400 ml (a bit more than 1 cup) and is 14 cm (5.5) tall. It comes with a lens-cap lid.4) Get them all! Buy the 3 Lens Mugs and save money.Please choose your favorite from the pulldown menu when ordering. The inside of the mug is lined with stainless steel, so are easily washable and keep your tea or coffee hot longer. Usage  Don't get these mugs mixed up with your real camera lenses! They are not functionally camera-friendly. The lids may look just like real lens caps, but can't be used as lens caps! They are not leakproof.Not microwave-safe. Handwash only. Wash before using for the first time. Made in China.
fields.name: Camera Lens Mug

fields.description: Casa Brutus is a famous Japanese magazine, mainly interior design oriented. If you're into Japanese design, cooking, life-style, photography and artcraft, these 2 magazines are for you. We're happy to present two Casa Brutus's extra issues : -????????????(best food from Japan). In Japanese, this magazine tells you about what, nowadays, is seen as the best products and food in Japan. Fish, sushi, rice of course, but not only. You'll then get to know how a chef is cultivating tomatoes, making his own cheese and prosciutto in a italian-style, from the japanese countryside. But also : fantastic bread, japanese or european pastries or the 16 tomatoes species that you can find across Japan.  If you're an epicurean like us and love to cook, you'll definitely devour this magazine by just looking at the pictures.   -Best of Nippon Design : is about Japanese artcraft. This issue has an incredible selection of traditional pieces representative of Japanese culture made to a function of day-to-day life. Japanese design is definitely above all fades, nothing old fashioned, just atemporal beauty.  Craftsmen from Kyoto have a great part in this issue (traditional knives from Aritsugu, Karacho fabrics or Kaikado's tea boxes). This extra issue is bilingual - Japanese and English. Full of details and historic landmarks, it's very interesting for Japan and Beauty lovers.These two Casa Brutus magazines are in a very limited quantity. Even if you're not familiar with Japanese language, you can enjoy browsing them and keep them as coffee-table books.
fields.name: Casa Brutus Magazine

fields.description: We love these beautiful Ceramic Knives for preparing food for bentos. They are available in two blade lengths and handle colors: 7.5 cm (2.95 ) long or 13 cm (5.12) long, with Maple or Walnut handles. Please choose one from the pulldown menu when ordering. FeaturesThe Ceramic knives are made of fire-hardened ceramic zirconium oxide, a material that is second only to diamond in hardness. This means that the blades retain their original razor sharpness for 10 times longer than ordinary steel knives. The blades impart no metallic taste to the food, making them perfect for cutting fresh fruit and vegetables, especially acidic ones such as lemons and tomatoes. And of course, since they are not made of metal, the blades don't corrode or rust! The natural wood composite handles are very comfortable to hold and are water resistant. The small 7.5cm (2.95) blade is suited to fine, detail work such as cutting delicate shapes out of vegetables or sausages for your bento, and the longer 13cm (5.12) is a great for everyday chopping and slicing. How to useFor prolonges enjoyment of these beautiful ceramic kitchen knives, please remember the following points : - always use on a wood cutting board or paps - hand wash and hang leave to dry, or wipe dry with a soft kitchen towl - use regular mild dishwashing detergent for cleaning - use a cleanser to gently scrub away any mild discoloration on the bladesCautionCeramic knives are for slicing, cutting and light chopping only. Do not use them to try to saw through bones, frozen food or shells to avoid breakage.  Ceramic is harder than metal, but less flexible. Do not use to twist, pry or scrape.  Keep away from children. Made in Japan.
fields.name: Ceramic Knives

fields.description: Homemade fat-free potato chips (crisps) in your bento, for snacks or for your next party? Thanks to the Chips Maker, it2019s possible! This handy kit allows you to slice and cook potatoes so that they turn out crisp and delicious, without using a drop of added fat! Features  The kit consists of:  - a transparent bowl with a yellow potato slicer. There is a a small white utensil to hold the potato as you slice it, keeping your fingers safe.  - the white Chip Maker stand. The thinly cut potato slices are inserted into each groove, and the stand is placed in the microwave, where the fat-free magic happens. The packing box measures 133 00d7 143 00d7 116(height) mm (4.44 x 5.62 x 4.56).Composition and care The white Chip Maker stand is made of  polymethylpenten. It is microwave and dishwasher safe.  The slicer is made of ABS, with a stainless steel blade. The transparent bowl is made of ACE. The slicer and bowl are not microwave safe and should be handwashed. Please be careful with the blade of the slicer when washing. Usually a rinse under running water will suffice.  ATTENTION!!!  The blade of the potato slicer is very sharp. Please use the white potato holder for your own safety. I nearly cut a piece of my finger right off when I tried slice a potato without using the potato holder. Keep the slicer away from children.  English instructions are included. Made in Japan.
fields.name: Chips Maker

fields.description: Choco Mold are two cute silicone molds in the shape of pig or bear little head. Pink Pig or Teddy Bear, choose your favorite from the pulldown menu. 100% made of silicone, you can microwave or bake oven it to make 16 fun chocolates, cookies or jellies ! Can also be used for cute ice cubes, putting it in the freezer. Choco Mold are microwave and dishwasher safe and have a non-stick surface - temperature range is -5000b0C + 22000b0C.  Funny detail for the Teddy Bear : one of them is winking, so kids can play to find who the lucky receiver is...Dimensions : 17.5x17.5x1.5cm (6.9x6.9x0.6)Made in China.
fields.name: Choco Mold

fields.description: Ciao Tutti Bento is a lunch box for kid, colorful and practical. Dimensions: 16,5cm x 10,5xm x 5,5cm (6.49 x 4.13 x 2.16). Capacity : 450ml.Has a clip-on lid which allows your kid to open it easily. The box is leakproof thanks to the silicone seals in the lid but it's not suitable for carrying liquid food (like a soup or sauce).Comes with a removal divider. Microwave and dishwasher safe with the lid removed. Made in Japan.
fields.name: Ciao Tutti Bento

fields.description: Onigiri lovers, here come the authentic wrappers for your triangle-shaped rice balls ! Combini Onigiri is a set of 2 different packs, 10 sheets each. So you can now make 20 genuine onigiri, like the one you would find in combini (Combini = 24/7 convenience store) in Japan !These wrapping sheets are either 14 x 24 cm (5.5 x 9.4) for a 7 to 8 cm long onigiri (2.7 x 3) or 12 x 22 cm (4.7 x 24), for a 5 to 6cm long onigiri.How to use it :To wrap your onigiri, follow the instructions and arrows printed on the outer plastic layer :   - first, place the nori (seaweed) sheet between the two layers (this is to keep the nori separated from the onigiri until the moment it is opened ensuring that the nori stays crisp and fresh). - flip the sheet over for the instructions to face down and put the onigiri toward the top edge of the nori sheet. - fold the bottom half of the sheet over the top half. Then fold the upper left edge of the wrapper sheet down over the left edge of the rice ball, and fold the bottom left edge of the wrapper back on top of it. And apply the sticker to close it (included).Et voil00e0, you have a pretty typical onigiri in your hands ! Check out the illustrations :To open it follow the 3 steps : grib the plastic between your thumb and forefinger, pull down, up and around. And pull both edges to take off the plastic  !Made of polypropylene, safe temperature range : 80 to -1000b0CMade in Japan.
fields.name: Combini Onigiri

fields.description: These are not bento boxes, but gorgeous wooden boxes with a unique fluorescent sliding lid. Made of colored Plexiglass, the lid captures the light and magically reflects it. This is a great box to store any kind of treasures, chocolates or jewelries. There're 14cm (5.5) wide, 15cm (5.9) long and 6,5cm (2.5) high and weight 210grams. Boxes can be stacked together as shown on the pictures. Please, choose the color of the wood between natural (the lightest), beige and dark, and the color of the lid between yellow, pink (sometimes it's orange depending on the light) and lime green.Made in Japan, in Shiga prefecture (Northeast of Kyoto).
fields.name: Container + Fluo Lid

fields.description: Cookies bag Paris is a set of 50 clear plastic bags. Use them to hold cookies or crackers, napkins or utensils, small pieces of fruit, or anything you can think of! Illustrated with stylish parisian designs in red, blue and black, the can easily be slip into your handbag or your kids school bags. DetailsEach set contains red, blue and black bags.  Measurements: 30cm (11.81) long, 13cm (5.11) wide and 5cm (1.96) depth. Material : polyester.Caution Not microwave safe.Made in China.
fields.name: Cookies bag Paris

fields.description: Cooking Hashi are 2 pairs of cooking japanese chopsticks. Cooking Hashi are not for eating but designed for food preparation. Much longer than the regular ones, these bamboo chopsticks are 13 long (33cm) and also thicker. This tool is very useful to deal with deep pots and are often used during deep-frying to turn foods over or transfer them safely. They're also ideal for food presentation in a plate or to beat eggs as Japanese people do.  You can buy 2 pairs of chopsticks for $2.50 (about 1,8020ac).Material : bamboo. Made in China.Do not put the chopsticks in an oven or near an open flame. Do not soak them for too long. Be sure to wash and dry them after use.
fields.name: Cooking Hashi

fields.description: Once you get into the bento lifestyle, you may find that you have a need for quite a lot of refrigerator containers to keep bits of food handy. Cube Stocker does the job with style.  Cube Stocker is a set of 4 cube shaped boxes in 4 colors (green, yellow, red and transparent) for keeping small bento-sized amounts of food in, plus a large outer container to hold the cubes. Use them to stock up on food for your bentos on the weekends, or to keep bits of leftovers. They can also be used for air-tight storage of spices or condiments. The bright colors add instant cheer to  your pantry, refrigerator or freezer.Cube Stocker is colorful and cute enough to use as a compartmentalized bento box too! Put 4 different kinds of food in the cubes, and carry them in the outer box. You could even use the colors to identify the contents - green for vegetables, red for meat, yellow for egg and so on.Each cube has its own sealing lid, and the transparent outer box also has a lid. Features Dimensions of the outer box: 251 mm x 65 mm x 55 mm (9.8 x 2.6 x 2.2). Each Cube holds 100 ml, for a total of 400 ml. The Cubes (not the outer box) are microwave, dishwasher and freezer safe, and are made of polypropelene. Made in Japan.
fields.name: Cube Stocker

fields.description: Can't get enough bento accessories? Or perhaps you're looking for that perfect little gift for a bento enthusiast? Then the Cup Cake accessory set may be for you! The Cup Cake accessory set includes 5 cute bento picks, with a cupcake-shaped sponge to hold them between uses, and 4 colorful, heatproof silicone cups, that can be used as divider cups inside your bento box or for baking cupcakes. They all stack together compactly for storage. The Cup Cake accessory set is available in 3 mouthwatering variations: - Blueberry - blueberry shaped picks with pink and purple cups and a strawberry-pink sponge;- Chocolate - piped white icing or whipped cream shaped picks with yellow, brown and orange cups and a chocolate sponge;- Strawberry - strawberry shaped picks with red, white and yellow cups and a vanilla spongePlease choose your favorite from the pulldown menu when ordering. A set of all three is also available for a discounted price. DimensionsThe picks are 5 cm (2 inches) long. The cups have a capacity of 76 ml, and are 68 mm in diameter x 35 mm high (2.68 x 1.38). The sponge is 60 mm in diameter x 48 mm high (2.36 x 1.89). Composition and careThe silicone cups are heat resistant up to 23000b0C (44500b0F) and are microwave, dishwasher, freezer and oven safe. (Safe temperature range: -3000b0C to 23000b0C, or -2200b0F to 44500b0F). The picks are made of ABS resin and should be handwashed. The sponge is made of polyurethane. Use the sponge for decorative purposes only. Made in China.

fields.description: The Cup Collection are silicon cups that help you organize your food and keep flavors separate inside your bento box.The Cup Collection consists of 3 different sets, please choose your favorite from the pulldown menu when ordering:Cup Heart is a set of 4 heart-themed pink cups.Cup 4 colors, red, yellow, green and purple little cupsCup Kawaii, 3 little cute cups in green, orange and pink.Silicon is very heat resistant, so you can microwave these cups without worrying about warping or melting them. Dimensions : 13cm long (5.11), 11cm wide (4.33) and 8cm high (3.14). Box is made of plastic PET, BPA free. Made in Japan by Hakoya.  Microwave and dishwasher safe, with lids removed. An ice-pack is also included, to be put in the freezer the day before. - Dimensions : 11 x 11 x 11cm (4.33 x 4.33 x 4.33) - Material :  ABS / PET plastic, BPA free - Microwave and dishwasher safe with lids removed.  Made in Japan.
fields.name: Deli Cup Soup

fields.description: Want a hot soup or risotto at noon? the Deli Mug Soup is for you!These sealed metal boxes can accommodate about 250 ml.Deli Mug Soup, with its beautiful round shape, comes to save us !Features:Dimensions: 12 cm (4.7) high, diameter, 8.5 cm (3.3) / capacity : 250 ml (8.45 Oz).This product can also keep fresh desserts, yogurt and fruit salad for example.Be sure to not fill to the brim, it is recommended to leave 1 cm between your soup and the beginning of the neck.The Delimug Soup is like a thermos. Be careful, Deli Mug Soup isn't microwave-safe.This product is available in three colors: pink, pistachio or red.Made in China.
fields.name: Deli Mug Soup

fields.description: Discover Japan is a monthly magazine about japanese culture. This issue (October 2012) is entirely about the beautiful city of Kyoto. If visiting Japan, especially Kyoto, is one of your dream or if you're planing to come and visit this beautiful imperial city, this magazine, may be one to get. Temples, best local restaurants, cafes or traditional houses to rent... Everything you need to discover the city and surroundings. The layout is gorgeous, with high quality images. This is a coffee table magazine to be browsed at leisure.232 pages. Printed in Japan. 100% in japanese but can be appreciated without reading japanese thanks to the nice pictures.
fields.name: Discover Japan: Kyoto, Fall 2012

fields.description: Discover Japan is a monthly magazine about japanese culture. This special Travel issue number 3 features beautiful and most renowned hotels and ryokan, the traditional accommodation facilities.If you plan to go to Japan one day, or if you just want to dream a little bit, this magazine, entirely written in japanese, will probably tempt you to spend one or two nights in one of those gorgeous places. Each hotel is presented with fantastic, large pictures, but Discover Japan also gives information such as hotel goodies (from Yukata to hotel's shampoo), description of the breakfast, room's view, furnitures...It's quite rare to have this kind of information, most of independents hotels and ryokan love to stay discreet about their little plus. 208 pages. fields.name: Discover Japan Travel

fields.description: The Dodecahedron, is a fascinating 12 sided geometric object. Made of wood, it includes a single sphere inside that cannot be taken out. No trick, this 'ball' has been realized with woodman's patience and perseverance, with more than 40 years of experience in wookworking.      Amazing : this technique feat is made by a woodman from south of Kyoto. With a single piece of wood, no screw no glue, he just needed tools to make holes, to sharpen and polish.     Philosophic : Dodecahedron has no particular purpose or meaning. You can not put food in it or play with it like a toy. Some researchers found similar ones in the Roman empire collapses, but today, the meaning hypothesis are still running. When you hold the Dodecahedron in your hand, you keep rolling it, wondering how it's made...    Beautiful : sharpen edges, inside roundness, wood feeling. This is just a gorgeous piece of art. A bit more about the Dodecahedron : The woodman saw a similar one 30 years ago and always wanted to make one by himself. It took years to conceiving it and to create the 3 special tools that he needed. We're lucky to have had the opportunity to meet him in Kyoto. Often isolated, crafstmen like him often have to create more marketable items. Imagining and making a Dodedadron is like a passion. Dodecahedron is made in Kyoto. Made of Keyaki wood (often used for japanese furnitures). High : 6,5 cm (2.5). 2 pieces available in stock. Production made on demand. Allow one day of work for a Dodecahedron.
fields.name: Dodecahedron

fields.description: Domo Kun, the official mascot of Japan's NHK television is now on Bento&co with this unique collection. OUT OF STOCK !This one is not a toy but a collector's item for Domu Kun fans. Only 400 pieces have been edited in the world. It's quite heavy so can steadily stand on a shelf. Made in China by Dark Hors Deluxe.

fields.description: Don to Genki Bento, ????????, is a standard bento cookbook in Japan. This book's topic is : bento for men, ???? in japanese. It looks easy to prepare a men's bento but this book actually contains lots of tips and details to make the bento more creative, healthy and good of course. You'll often fill 2/3 of the box with plain rice, a bit of meat or fried fish and some sauteed vegetables. Everything neatly packed in a L box and voil00e0 ! Don to Genki Bento is a cookbook in japanese. We've selected it for you because of the great pictures and step-by-step explanations. Of course, you'll need to know how to read japanese if you want to get into it deeper. Dimensions : 20cm high, 21cm width (7.8 x 8.2) 95 pages. Published in February 1998. Printed in Japan. About the writer : Kentaro, born in 1973 is the son of a famous TV cooking program presenter. Following his mother's step, he published about 15 cookbooks in Japan.
fields.name: Don to Genki Bento

fields.description: Donburi Animal Cup is a set of three adorable little cups shaped like a panda, piglet and chick. These cups are meant to hold small portions of condiments like mayonnaise, ketchup, salad dressing and so on inside your bento box. The lids have a hermetic seal that keeps the contents from leaking out all over your other food. The cups also add a splash of cheery color to your box without having to cut out food or anything! FeaturesDonburi Animal Cup chicken: - capacity : 4 ml (a bit less than a teaspoon) - dimensions : 3 cm diameter (1.2) Donburi Animal Cup piglet : - capacity : 15 ml (a tablespoon) - dimensions : 4 cm diameter (1.6)Donburi Animal Cup panda : - capacity : 19 ml (a tablespoon + teaspoon)  - dimensions : 5 cm diameter (2)Composition and careMade of ABS. Not microwave safe. The hermetic seal on the lids is guaranteed 100%. The content will not leak, according to the manufacturer, during transit, but do watch out when opening and closing them. Made in China.

fields.description: The Dressing Bottle is the ideal way of packing a little bit of sauce or dressing in your bento box. Material: polypropylene and polyethylene. Not microwave safe. Handwashing is recommended.Designed in Japan by Torune, manufactured in China.

It has English subtitles so that you won't miss anything, though the video instructions are very clear on their own. The DVD is divided into two sections: How to wrap objects, with 8 different methods shownHow to carry objects, with 7 different methods shown Get full use out of your furoshiki collection with this useful DVD! fields.description: One single stainless steel container: Eco Lunch Box Solo Cube is 100% plastic free. Perfect to carry a fresh sandwich or a desert. This square box's dimensions are 13cm long and wide (5.12) and 4,5cm high (1.77).It's unbreakable, easy to clean, long-lasting, dishwasher safe and completely plastic-free!The lid closes neatly the box, but if you want, you can add an elastic band (Lunch Band) or a Furoshiki to carry it.Not microwave safe and not leak-proof.Made in India by the American company Eco-friendly.

fields.description: You're a non-plastic person ? Eco Lunchbox is for your. Three boxes in one, in stainless steel, without a piece of plastic. The size is perfect for a kid lunch or an adult lunch with a sandwich and 2 side dishes. Eco Lunchbox comes with a 2-tier bento and a small container with a lid that can be stocked in the upper tier. When closed, the box is 13,6cm long (5.35), 10,2cm wide (4) and 7,5cm high (2.95).Why a stainless bento box ? Because it's unbreakable, easy to wash (dishwasher safe), lasts for a very long time and... is entirely plastic free !The box is not microwave safe and not leak-proof.Made in India for a very Eco-friendly american company!

fields.description: Here is a new range of colorful boxes : the Edge bento. If you don't have enough to eat with the Iro Iro ones, the Edge bento is for you !Size L.Product descriptionWith its three-tier, this box will follow you from the morning to your lunch break. Indeed, the Edge box consists in 3 compartments of 400 ml each, for a total capacity of 1,2 L ! The whole box is compact and light enough so you can easily carry it in a bag. And thanks to the elastic band, the 3 compartments remain united. If you want to use just 2 compartments, place the elastic band horizontally. Edge bento box comes with a black polyester bag which enable you not only to carry your bento, but also other side dish, such as fruits or biscuits. Four colors are available, for 2 of the 3 compartments : black, blue, pink and lime green. The 3-tier is very useful if, for instance, you want to bring your breakfast (one compartment) and your lunch (two compartments) in the same box. Actually, Edge bento is perfect for salary men and active women like you. In Japan, for high school students who are always hungry, we use the term Haya Ben ??  ( Hayai Bento / fast bento) for a bento eaten between two lessons at 10 o'clock. Well yes, Japanese people are hungry (specially when they are teens and play baseball 2 hours a day ! ).FeaturesThis is a 3-tier bento box. It's available in four colors: Black, Bue, Pink and Lime Green. Please choose your favorite from the pulldown menu when ordering.Total capacity : 1200 ml. Dimensions : 95 00d7 165 00d7 125 mm. (3,7 x 6,49 x 4,9) Weight : 370 g. Come with a black and grey elastic band and a black bag.Boxes400 ml eachPOLYPROPYLENESac240x300x100 mmPOLYESTER CautionThis box is dishwasher safe, inner lids (transparent) removed. It's microwave safe without inner lids (transparent) and main lid. Max power 700 watts, no more than 2 minutes. The bag is washing machine safe. Do not place in the oven or near an open flame.Made in Japan
fields.name: Edge

fields.description: The Edo Bento is a beautifully crafted, genuine wooden bento box of real distinction. It's sure to take pride of place in your bento box collection! Size M. Presentation  The Edo Bento Box is a close cousin of our beloved Kyo Bento box.  Edo ????is the old name of Tokyo, and Kyo ???is an abbreviation of Kyoto! Traditionally, Kyoto has been the town with the soft, feminine image, while Edo or Tokyo has has a harder, masculine image. Since the Kyo Bento Box has rounded lines, we think that Edo is a perfect name for this squarer box. Like its rounded cousin the Edo Bento Box is a two-tier,  traditional wooden bento box, made of wood from the harigiri (kaloponax) tree called sen. The slightly open grain of the wood and the warm reddish-brown color adds to its natural charm. The rectangular tiers have rounded corners, to make digging out your food with chopsticks easy. The box is hand made by a skilled artisan in Aizu, Fukushima prefecture, an area known its skilled wood crafters. The box is finished with food grade polyurethane to show off the wood to its best advantage. This product is made of wood cut long before the 11 March 2011, in an area far from the Fukushima nuclear plant. This product and others from this maker are absolutely not dangerous. Safety is our first concern, and we continue to support these artisans in this difficult time.Features Total capacity: 770ml (380ml for the upper tier, 390ml for the lower tier). There is a matching wooden lid, and one T-shaped internal wooden divider. Dimensions: 17.5 cm long x 10 cm wide x 9 cm high (6.9 x 3.9 x 3.54). We recommend using a furoshiki wrapping cloth for wrapping and transporting this bento box. The Edo Bento Box comes packaged in a beautiful presentation box - perfect for gift giving. Composition and care 100% wood, with a food grade polyurethane finish. Not microwave, oven or dishwasher safe! Hand wash only using cold or lukewarm water and a mild dishwashing detergent if needed. Dry with a soft cloth. Do not leave soaking in water. Oils that may leech from your food just deepen the color of the wood. With proper care, this box is sure to become a treasured family heirloom. Made in Fukushima, Japan.
fields.name: Edo Bento

fields.description: Elephant Oshibori case is a lovely elephant-shaped box to carry your oshibori (small hand towel) or anything you want.  The screw-on head lid closes steadily the box. Comes with a wrist-strap. Attention, the hand towel is not included. Features : Dimensions : 107 x 60 x 60cm (4.21 x 2.36 x 2.36) Composition : plastic PP et ABS Made in China
fields.name: Elephant oshibori case

fields.description: Do you want to try your hand at making some cute charaben, or decorative bentos? Then the Food Cutters Set is for you! There are two different sets to choose from, for all of your creative food decorating needs. Each Food Cutters Set kit consists of 12 food cutters. Choose from:  - Enikki Set, for small elements, including an umbrella, a shooting star or a little boy.  (Enikki means illustrated diary in Japanese.)  - Okazu Set, for bigger elements with vegetables and kawai shapes. (Okazu means the foods that are eaten with the main carbohydrate (usually plain rice) in Japanese.)  Each set also includes a pair of tweezers and a plastic pin, to aid you in placing the tiny cut-out shapes in your creative bentos.TipsThese cutters work best with cooked food, such as ham, cooked egg, and boiled or steamed vegetable slices. You can also use them on fruit.  They work best with food that's at least 3mm (1/10th of an inch) thick, and a bit flexible. Do not try to cut nori seaweed with this - you'll just get frustrated! (Use one of our nori punches for this task.) Features Composition: PET plastic. Hand washing is recommended. Not microwave safe.The colors of the food cutters may vary from the photo. Made in Japan.
fields.name: Food Cutters Set

fields.description: Little vintage soldiers to keep an eye on your sushi, to patrol your sausage or to conquer your neighbor's petit-fours ! Food Fighters will make you feel like a kid again and you will, at last, play with your food ! This set includes two teams of 6 soldiers-picks, reusable (so 12 picks in total). The toy soldiers are 2 inches tall (5cm) plus a 1 inch (2,5cm) pick on each leg.Made in plastic PP, food safe.  Hand wash only. Made in China.
fields.name: Food Fighters

fields.description: The Freep Cup set is an ingenious solution for busy bentoists. It's a set of 8 small containers or bento cups that can be packed with food, then placed straight in your bento box to go. The Freep Cup set contains 6 small cube-shaped cups, plus 2 rectangular cups, all made of practical silicone. You can pack them in advance with bento-ready food, and put them in the refrigerator or freezer ready to go. Because they are made of silicone they can be reheated in the microwave or even the oven. There's also a large storage box to keep all the Freeps in one neat place. The Freep Cup set contains: - 6 silicone cube cups in 3 colors (yellow, orange and green). Each cube holds 40 ml and  is 5 cm (about 2 inches) square and 3 cm (about 1 inch) deep. - 2 silicone rectangular cups, one each of orange and green, to match the cubes. Each rectangle holds 80 ml and is 9.5 cm x 5 cm x 3 cm (3.7 x 2 x 1)- A transparent storage box with lid that holds all of your Freep Cups, that measures 25.5 cm x 11 cm x 4 cm (10 x 4.3 x 1.6)The silicone Freep cups are microwave, oven, freezer and dishwasher safe. Wash before using for the first time. Made in China.
fields.name: Freep Cup

fields.description: Fresco Wood Green is a beautiful imitation wood grain green box. With a large capacity, it is suitable for those with big appetites. Size L Description Fresco Wood Green is a two tier bento with a total capacity of 900ml. It is possible to use only one of the tiers if you have the need ever.Each tier has its own inner lid to keep your food, but you should avoid putting foods that have a lot of liquid in it. Characteristics Capacity: 900ml (450 x 2) Dimensions: 170 x 105 x 79mm The box comes with an elastic strap. Material: PET, A Can go in the dishwasher without inner lids.  This bento, except for the inner lids, is microwave safe (at a maximum power of 700 watts for no more than 2 minutes. Do not put in an oven or on the stove.   Made in Japan, in Ishikawa Prefecture.
fields.name: Fresco Green Wood

fields.description: Freshness Keepers, are cute ice pack for your bento, to keep your salad, fruits or anything else fresh longer. Four different Freshness Keepers are available. You can either put them in your bento's lid or in a isothermal bag. You can also you them for your beverage.  -Doughnuts Strawberry.  Yummy ! (do not eat it!).  -Doughnuts Chocolate. Slurp ! (again, do not eat it!).How does it work ? Just put your Freshness Keepers in the freezer the night before. The gel-like substance will then transform to ice and keep your bento cool for about 4 hours (at room temperature, about 2500b0C)Dimensions :     -Doughnuts : 11cm in diameter (4,3) and 0,5cm thick (0,2)    -Sweets Mitubashi : 10cm in diameter (3,9) and 0,7cm thick (0,3)Be careful, don't make any hole in it, otherwise you could not use it anymore. Keep away from children.Check out others  Ice Pack on Bento&Co here. Made in Japan
fields.name: Freshness Keeper

fields.description: Fridgeezoo have now two more friends and they speak english ! Please welcome the Polar Bear couple straight from Los Angeles, yeah baby !For those who don't know them, these cute animal friends come in a milk carton shaped form and are meant to be placed inside your refrigerator.Equipped with a temperature sensor, they start out friendly enough, greeting you when you open the fridge, but quickly turn on you if you keep the door open for too long. It's a great reminder for your kids to not keep the door open for too long too, or for you roomate to not take the last piece of cake during the night.If regular Fridgeezoos speak japanese, this couple want to greet and warn you in english.Two Fridegeezoo From L.A are available :The blue ear boy (Polar Boy), Heday and the red ear girl (Polar Girl), Valerie.A list of their sentences is included, but if you pay attention, you will find some surprised ones...Check out this Fridgeezoo From L.A video: Fridgeezoo is equipped with both a light sensor and a temperature sensor. Place Fridgeezoo in your refrigerator, preferably in a location that gets lit brightly when the door is open. (In other words, it works better if you place it in the middle of a shelf rather than in a dark corner.) At  4 cm wide x 9 cm tall (1.6 x 3.5) it takes up very little space. Fridgeezoo has an on/off switch on the bottom, and a small tab that must be snapped off before you use it for the first time. Requires 3 LR44 alkaline button cell batteries (included). To clean, wipe with a damp cloth.  Designed in Tokyo, made in China.
fields.name: Fridgeezoo From L.A

fields.description: Fridgeezoo's family is getting even bigger with the coming of the new Fridgeezoo Hogen ! Fridgeezoo Hogen, are cute milk bottle shaped animals that sits in your refrigerator. Hogen means dialect in japanese because they will greet you and invite you to close the door in their own regional language. And just for the anecdote, they're loosing their home because of the global warming so they now take refuge in human refrigerators !And something new and fun, when you push on the up button, they make a burp sound !Fridgeezoo Hogen come in 4 animals :- Shiro Kuma, the polar bear with red hat comes from Kagoshima, located on the Kyushu island. - Pengin, is from Kyoto (our favorite, of course)- Seuichi, the (brown) walrus is from Okinawa, a heavenly island in the Pacific Ocean. and Azarashi, the (white) seal from Iwate, North-East of Japan. FeaturesFridgeezoo is equipped with both a light sensor and a temperature sensor. Place Fridgeezoo in your refrigerator, preferably in a location that gets lit brightly when the door is open. (In other words, it works better if you place it in the middle of a shelf rather than in a dark corner.) At  4 cm wide x 9 cm tall (1.6 x 3.5) it takes up very little space. Fridgeezoo has an on/off switch on the bottom, and a small tab that must be snapped off before you use it for the first time. Requires 3 LR44 alkaline button cell batteries (included). To clean, wipe with a damp cloth. Made in China. Watch this video of Fridgezoo in action:
fields.name: Fridgeezoo Hogen

fields.description: Are you a fan of cute and slightly strange Japanese products? Do your midnight forays to the fridge seem a bit lonely? Then Fridgeezoo is for you! Fridgeezoo is a small milk carton shaped box that sits quietly in your refrigerator. When you open the door, it greets you in Japanese, saying things such as Hallo! or Are you snacking again? It has a practical energy-saving purpose too, since it's equipped with a temperature sensor. If you leave the door open too long, it complains it's too hot in here!. It's a great reminder for your kids to not keep the door open for too long too. We have three Fridgeezoo arctic animal characters available but also two new animal farms characters! Please choose your favorite when ordering. Shirokuma (Polar Bear) is an easygoing romantist, who likes nothing more than to hibernate. If he gets too warm though, he turns a bit grumpy.Seiuchi (Walrus) is a happy-go-lucky soul with a slight lisp because of his large tusks. Those tusks love to stay cool so don't leave the fridge door open too long. Azarachi (Seal) with an high-pitched little voice, it will gently ask you to close the door so its ice caps won't melt.Pengin (Penguin) is an ice-lover and will definitely lose patience as well if you let your fridge door open too long. Ushi (Cow), the milk carton fits her so well!Buta (Pig) has a really cute voice and is afraid of sausages inside your fridge.Tora (Tiger) feels quite alone here among all these farm and polar animals.Liss (Squirrel) won't eat anything in your fridge. Well, we hope so...Characteristics, care and usage Fridgeezoo is equipped with both a light sensor and a temperature sensor. Place Fridgeezoo in your refrigerator, preferably in a location that gets lit brightly when the door is open. (In other words, it works better if you place it in the middle of a shelf rather than in a dark corner.) At  4 cm wide x 9 cm tall (1.6 x 3.5) it takes up very little space. Fridgeezoo has an on/off switch on the bottom, and a small tab that must be snapped off before you use it for the first time. Requires 3 LR44 alkaline button cell batteries (included). To clean, wipe with a damp cloth. Fridgeezoo speaks one of 9 phrases (plus a couple of 'secret' ones) in Japanese when you open the refrigerator. If the refrigerator is left open for too long, it will start complaining. The Fridgeezoo characters are voiced by members of Romancecrew, a Japanese hip-hop band. Made in China. Watch this video of Fridgezoo in action:
fields.name: Fridgeezoo

fields.description: The Fukuro Bento has a quiet, nature-inspired design, reminiscent of a Japanese forest. Fukuro is the Japanese word for owl -- and sure enough, there's a little owl perched quietly on a branch with a full moon printed on the lid. This box is large enough for an active adult. Fukuro Bento is available in two colors: light or dark (the illustration varies between the two models).Size L.FeatureFukuro Bento is a two-tier bento box. The top tier has a flexible, leak-resistant semi-transparent lid. The surface of the outer lid and bottom tier have a simulated woodgrain look; the top tiers and interiors are black.  Total volume: 900 ml (upper compartment: 450 ml, lower compartment: 450 ml).  Size: 18 00d7 10 00d7 8.4 cm (7 x 3.9 x 3.3). Sold with an elastic black bento band. Composition and precautionsMaterial of box: Plastic with a safe temperature range of -2000b0C to 14000b0C (-400b0F to 28400b0F)). Material of inside lid: polyethylene (temperature supported: -20 to 6000b0C).The box itself is microwave and dishwasher safe. Remove the outer and inner lids before putting in the microwave. Handwashing is recommended for the inner lid. Do not use in the oven or near an open flame. Made in Japan.
fields.name: Fukuro Bento

fields.description: Funny Friends Bento are two little boxes for kids in aluminium. The lunch boxes made in aluminium are still very popular in Japan for lunch at school or preschool. It's also an ideal container for parents who want to avoid plastic boxes. Aluminium boxes are light yet sturdy. You can also easily wash them thanks to their rounded corners. Aluminium does not affect the taste or the color of the food like bad plastic boxes can sometimes do. Comes with a small removal container, but the lunch band is not included.  If you don't have one, we recommend the 24cm long. Capacity: 340ml.  Dimensions: 9,4 x 13,1 x 4,2cm (3.7x5.15x1.65) Weight : 96grams. Not microwave or dishwasher safe. Made in Japan. Note : the little text in the outer lid is written in a funny English typically Japanese : Cute rabbit. This house is full dreams. I'll take them up one by one and bring all up carefully.
fields.name: Funny Friends Bento

fields.description: Furikake Panda is a a very cute panda shaped container for holding furikake or any kind of dry condiment. It's a great gift for anyone who loves kawaii goods! FeaturesFurikake Panda is composed with 2 elements (head and body), which pivot to close or to open the pouring hole. The hole is about 1 cm (.4) in diameter. The specially shaped spoon for filling your bottle with is 9 cm (3.5) long. (It has a tiny panda on the handle!) Overall dimensions : 4.5 cm high x 3 cm in diamete (1.8 x .1.2) Volume : 14 ml (about 1 tablespoon).Lid and base made of polypropylene. Spoon made of ABS resin.Caution Furikake Panda is not microwave and dishwasher safe.Made in China (home of the real panda!)PS : Furikake is a dry or semi-dry savory condiment, usually made from things like sesame seeds, nori seaweed and bonito flakes. It's used in Japanese cooking for sprinkling onto plain rice and other things.
fields.name: Furikake Panda

fields.description: Furikake Piyo Piyo is an adorable little chick-shaped container that holds dry condiments, for sprinkling onto your food. It's sure to bring a smile to anyone seeing it! FeaturesFurikake Piyo Piyo (piyo piyo is the sound that chicks make in Japanese!) is a small two-part container; the parts can be twisted apart in order to put in a dry condiment such as pepper, sesame seeds or herbs. The beak of the little chick is the spout; twist the lid/head to expose the opening, and tap the container lightly to sprinkle. Twist the lid/head again to close. In Japan it's usually used to contain furikake, a yummy savory dry condiment that's a great sprinkle for plain rice. Measurements: 45 00d7 45 00d7 53 (height) mm ( 1.77 x 1.77 x 2.0 (height) ) The beak spout is 8mm (.31) long. Capacity: 54 ml (a bit more than 3 tablespoons). Compositions and precautionsMade of polypropylene. Not microwave safe. Handwashing is recommended. Made in China.
fields.name: Furikake Piyo Piyo

fields.description: Furoshiki Aka Karakusa is a gorgeous 50 cm (19.4) square cloth. Reversible, you can play with colors and patterns with both the vivid red and the white swirling pattern called karakusa. This traditional pattern evolved hundreds of years ago from spiral floral motifs on cloths that came over from Persia and China. In the Japanese version, the flowers have disappeared, leaving an abstract, almost modern looking design. Furoshiki are traditional Japanese wrapping cloths (Wikipedia). They used to be used for everything - as an impromptu bag, for wrapping things for storage, as a reusable gift wrapping. Furoshiki have been making a comeback in Japan in recent years, as a beautiful, reusable and eco-friendly way of wrapping things up! The colors of the Furoshiki Aka Karakusa make it perfect to wrap your christmas present with style. The fabric is thick but soft enough to easily fold and knot it. How to wrap a bento box in a furoshiki Place the bento box in the middle of the furoshiki. If the box is square in shape, place it on the diagona, so the sides are facing the corners of the cloth. Bring two opposite corners of the cloth over the box and tie securely. Bring the other two corners over the cloth, and tie again. You can find instructions on the web for fancy knots that create carrying handles and so on, but the basic tying method is simple! Features Furoshiki Karakusa is made of 100% cotton. It is machine-washable; use the gentle cycle and lukewarm water  (recommended maximum water temperature: 40 degrees C / 104 degrees F). It is relatively wrinkle-free, but you can iron it to keep it pristine. Made in Japan.
fields.name: Furoshiki Aka Karakusa

fields.description: Furoshiki Hokusai  is a series of 3 magnificent furoshiki cloths, printed in superb quality with iconic woodblock prints from the Edo period. These furoshiki are not only great for wrapping your bento boxes in, they could be displayed as works of art! You have your choice of 3 designs: Aka Fuji (the Red Fuji), from 36 Views of Mount Fuji, the best known collection of works by iconic woodblock artist HokusaiNami-ura ni Fuji, also known in English as The Great Wave Off Kanagawa, the best known work by HokusaiSharaku, a portait of Kabuki actor Otani Onijuin by Sharaku, another well regarded woodblock artist. This painting was profoundly influential to European artists of the19th to early 20th centuries, most notably Toulouse-Lautrec. Please choose your favorite from the pulldown menu when ordering. These make great gifts for lovers of traditional Japanese art.Composition and Care The Furoshiki Hokusai cloths measure 68 cm (26.75) square, larger than most of our other furoshiki cloths. They are great for wrapping our long-format bento boxes such as the Nami Bento, or the round-format boxes like Owan Sakura. They're also perfect for transporting wine or sake bottles (or our bottle-shaped kitchen tool set Bin 8). What a great way to gift a a special bottle to someone! 100% rayon (artificial silk). Dry cleaning is recommended. Use a cool iron for pressing. Made in Japan. There are many instructional videos and web pages online where you can see how to utilize a furoshiki. Check out this great site by the Japanese Ministry of the Environment to start. And to get full use out of your furoshiki, check out this instructional DVD.

fields.description: Furoshiki Matsu is a gorgeous 50 cm (19.7) square wrapping cloth, for wrapping around your bento box. When unwrapped it doubles as a small tablecloth.  The size is great for any of our bento boxes, and is especially recommended for use with our genuine wood bento boxes. The ground color is a sophisticated purple, the official color of the city of Kyoto, and it's printed overall with a stylized matsu or pine motif in yellow and white, that is traditional yet quite modern and contemporary looking. Furoshiki are traditional Japanese wrapping cloths (Wikipedia). They used to be used for everything - as an impromptu bag, for wrapping things for storage, as a reusable gift wrapping. Furoshiki have been making a comeback in Japan in recent years, as a beautiful, reusable and eco-friendly way of wrapping things up! How to wrap a bento box in a furoshiki Place the bento box in the middle of the furoshiki. If the box is square in shape, place it on the diagona, so the sides are facing the corners of the cloth. Bring two opposite corners of the cloth over the box and tie securely. Bring the other two corners over the cloth, and tie again. You can find instructions on the web for fancy knots that create carrying handles and so on, but the basic tying method is simple! See this page for more furoshiki wrapping and tying ideas. Features Furoshiki Matsu is made of 100% cotton. It is machine-washable; use the gentle cycle and lukewarm water  (recommended maximum water temperature: 40 degrees C / 104 degrees F). It is relatively wrinkle-free, but you can iron it to keep it pristine. Made in Japan.
fields.name: Furoshiki Matsu

fields.description: Back to the future with the new Casio watch collection ! Two different watches are available : 1) Calculator Databank watch, in Silver or Gold. In addition to the regular functions (time, date, alarm-clock, light), this watch includes a real calculator (yes !) and a Telememo 25 function. Telememo 25 is a data base which allows you to save 25 contacts (name and phone number). Imagine that you forget your phone somewhere or run out of power, this super-watch can save your life ! You may love the look more than anything, but if your really want to get into every function, don't worry, the watch comes with an english guide. 2) Wave Ceptor watch, is for those who always want to be on time, everywhere. At night, this watch get a time calibration signal and set it right. This signal is driven directly by atomic clocks which are radio-controlled...For the record atomic clock doesn't mean the watch is radioactive ! So the watch is automatically on time, all the time, everywhere in the world. It comes with an english guide.  Strap is in plastic. Waterproof (5 bar)Made in China by Casio.  Comes in a blue jewel box.

fields.description: Keep your lunch fresh and cool for hours with the Gel Cool boxes like an icebox would do.Each Gel Cool Double comes with 2 tier, one in color, one in white (except for the black-black).It's never pleasant to eat salads that are too warm, but it's too easy to forget to pack an ice pack with your box. The Gel Coolboxes deals with this problem very neatly with an ice pack built right into the top lid. Simply pop the lid in your freezer the night before. Food packed in the box with a pre-cooled lid will be kept cold for several hours. Each box has a removable inner divider, and a lid with an inner flexible, hermetically sealing element that makes the lid quite leak-proof. It comes with an elastic bento band. This one has only two tier with a capacity of 500ml each so 1000ml in total. Dimensions : 8.6cm00d717.8cm00d76cm (3.38 x 7 x 2.36). Composition and Care The outer part of the lid is made of ABS (safe temperature range: -2000b0C to 6000b0C (-400b0F to 14000b0F)), and the inner divider element is made of polypropelene (safe temperature range: -2000b0C to 14000b0C (-400b0F to 28400b0F)). The flexible seal around the inside of the lid is made of silicone (safe temperature range: -4000b0C to 18000b0C (-4000b0F to 36000b0F)). The flexible inner lid is made of an elastomere (safe temperature range : -6000b0C to 12000b0C (-7600b0F to 24800b0F)).The boxes are microwave and dishwasher safe with the lids removed. The lids should be hand washed. The white silicone sealing element and the inner lid, can be removed for easy washing. Made in Hokkaido, by Gel Design.

fields.description: To make a bento stash for busy mornings, have you ever though of freezing your rice ? In Japan, if some rice still remains in the rice-cooker, people just freeze it, using this kind of one-portion boxes. Here come 2 different simple ones, which provides great flexibility in the morning : - 5 boxes set : each box allows you to freeze up to 250ml of rice (or anything you like), which is the perfect portion for filling up one-tier of your bento. - 2 boxes set : triangle shaped which is perfect to make an onigiri. Use it as a mold and unfreeze it in the morning. The boxes are microwave safe by opening the cap of the lid. Also, the shape of the box allows the rice to defrost faster. How to use To defrost the rice, place the box in the microwave, with the lid closed but let the cap opened. For the 250ml box : 500W : 3,5 minutes / 1000W : 2,5 minutes. For the onigiri box : 500W 2mn. Made in JapanMaterial : polypropylene.
fields.name: Gohan Reito Boxes

fields.description: Gyoza dumplings are delectable treats that came to Japan from China. Filled with a mixture of meat and vegetables and boiled, steamed or pan-fried, they are absolutely delicious. However, they are rather difficult to make at for the inexperienced home cook. That's where Gyoza Tools comes to the rescue! This handy little kit consists of a dumpling crimping tool and a small spatula. Simply place a gyoza dumpling skin on the crimper, put a little filling in the middle with the spatula, and fold the crimper over. Gyoza dumpling skins can be purchased at Japanese or Asian/Chinese grocery stores. You can find lots of sites with  instructions for making gyoza dumplings. Gyoza Tools is made of polypropelene. Hand washing is recommended. Wash with mild detergent before using the first time. Do not use near an open flame. Made in Japan.
fields.name: Gyoza Tools

fields.description: The Hachi Oshibori is a little bumblebee shaped container for carrying a small, moistened towel, or oshibori (???) to wipe your hands clean before and after eating lunch. A small cotton towel is included. If you have been to a Japanese restaurant, you may have encountered oshibori already -  moist towels for wiping your hands and face before you start a meal. Oshibori are really refreshing! Now you can bring your own moistened oshibori along with your bento, especially to places where you may not have a place to wash your hands before eating. Kids are more likely to wipe their hands properly when the towel container is so cute too! The Hachi Oshibori container consists of two parts. The head pops off easily to reveal the towel inside. Attached to the Hachi Oshibori  container is a flower-shaped  tag for writing your child's name on (or your name for that matter), so that it can be returned to its owner if it gets misplaced. Hachi Oshibori is 9 cm long and 5.5 cm wide (3.54 long, 2.2 wide) and is made of ABS. Handwashing is recommended. The towel is 100% cotton and is machine washable. Made in China by Torune.
fields.name: Hachi Oshibori

fields.description: At last! A cookbook for Kyaraben lovers.The entire title is : ??????????????????????????????! Let's start Kyaraben bento. Make a cute bento even during your busy morning!This book has two main parts :        - Part 1 : advices and examples of bento through 4 themes : animal-bento, doll-bento, vehicle-bento and season-bento (Spring, Christmas...).    - Part 2 : tons of Okazu recipes, you know those little side dishes that composed a japanese bento, in addition to the traditional rice. They are listed by color, because of course, Kyaraben bento is supposed to be beautiful first !For instance, you'll know how to prepare : A bear-shaped onigiri, green (beans, asparagus...), red (meat balls ?) and yellow (squash gratin in a silicone cup) and here you'll have a  nice bento, perfect for kids...or for you. 66 pages. Printed in Japan. First edition in 2009.The Japanese blogger Asami presents a lots of those recipes in her blog.

Hako Ben Kit  is a set of a colorful bento and a pair of matching chopsticks.PresentationHako Ben includes a hidden tier with an internal lid in the main container. This tier can be placed inside or below the main container, depending on the volume of your lunch: If you put the tier inside the main container, the total capacity is 680ml (330ml + 350ml). fields.description: Hashi Testudo (Railway chopsticks), are 8 neat pairs of chopsticks that take the form of Japan's famous bullet (Shinkansen) and local trains.In Japan, trains are a big part of the culture. Some Japanese people started worshipping trains and everything which goes with railways quite a long time ago. Indeed, there's every reason for that : punctuality, frequency, fastness and a great service in general.These chopsticks are great for every Japanophiles but they serve perfectly as regular chopsticks too. They're made of AS plastic and they're 21cm long (8.26).1) Doctor Yellow 923: a yellow Shinkansen, called Doctor because it's the one which check the tracks and catenaries.2) Shinkansen Mizuho Sakura N700 : this train connects the main island (Honshu) to the big south island Kyushu. It's light-blue and has a long nose.3) Shinkansen N700: same look but white with a blue line.4) Shinkansen N500: the West Shinkansen, goes at 300Km/h. Grey body, a blue line on the top and a sharp nose.5) Shinkansen 0: the very first Shinkansen put in operation in 1964. White and a thin blue line and a small round nose. 6) Keihan 6000: a local train which connect Kyoto to Osaka in less than one hour.7) JR Yamanote: the famous green line connecting most of Tokyo's major stations. 8) JR Osaka Loop Line: like the Yamanote, but for Osaka and in Orange. Hand-washing is recommended.  Made in Japan.
fields.name: Hashi Tetsudo

fields.description: The Heart Sando is a brand new pocket sandwich maker from Bento&co, that creates 5 cute little sandwiches in one go! Great for bentos, for snacks, and for parties too. A pocket sandwich is two pieces of sandwich bread that are cut and sealed on the edges, with filling inside. Pocket sandwiches are cute and easy to eat, especially for small children. They are very popular in Japan, and are sold at supermarkets and convenience stores (konbini). The Heart Sando (sando is Japanese for sandwich) is a two-part sandwich maker/cutter. To use, make a sandwich with two pieces of soft bread, with small spoonfuls of filling placed where the sandwich cutouts will be. Try peanut butter and jelly or jam, Nutella, tuna salad, or whatever you or your kids like. Take care not to overfill or the edges may not seal. Put the sandwich in between the two parts, and press hard. You'll get tiny heart shaped sandwiches plus a puffy square one in one go! There are clear illustrative step-by-step photos on the package. There are even some recipes ideas for the leftover bread parts.Tip: To help the bread edges seal, put the sandwich bread in a plastic bag and microwave on high for a few seconds, to make it slightly moist.  (For a one-piece pocket sandwich maker, check out the Panda Sando!) Composition and care Made of polypropelene. Not microwave safe. Hand washing is recommended. Made in China.
fields.name: Heart Sando

fields.description: Hello Kitty Bakery is the very first Hello Kitty bento series we are bringing to you. Four items are available: the Hello Kitty Bakery Bento Box Set, Hello Kitty Fork and Spoon Set, Hello Kitty Mini Cute Box , and the Hello Kitty Bakery Drawstring Bag. Please choose your favorite from the pulldown menu when ordering - or you may want the whole set!The bento boxes range from size S to M. FeaturesThe Hello Kitty Bakery Bento Box Set consists of 4 boxes that nest together for compact storage. They range in size from S to M, with capacities of 100 ml, 180 ml, 300 ml and 480 ml respectively. The largest box, into which all the other boxes can be stored, measures 142mm (length) x 95mm (width) x 55mm (height) (5.6 x 3.75 x 2.17). The lids fit securely and are leak resistant. The lids are decorated with Hello Kitty and her friends with all kinds of cute baked goodies. Tip: The smaller boxes make great inner containers to put into larger bento boxes. The smallest one for example makes a perfect, leakproof dipping sauce or dressing container. The Hello Kitty fork and spoon set is made of  sturdy metal, stamped with Hello Kitty motifs. They are sized perfectly for small hands, though adults love them too! The Hello Kitty Mini Cute box is a small and very kawaii box. fields.description: Here come three knives in very good quality, from K00f4chi prefecture's craftmen, on Shikoku island.  Hokiyama knives are unique in combining a japanese traditional blade and a robust handle from western inspiration.  We're glad to present three knives, with different sizes and colors.- Sankoku 180mm With its 18cm (7) blade, this universal knife will let you cut a good roast beef, chop vegetables or fillet a fresh fish. - Brown 135mm This is an ideal knife for daily use: fruits, vegetables, chicken, etc. 13,5cm (5.31) blade. - Black 135mm High quality chef's knife with elaborated blade. Also suitable for a daily use. Features- Sankoku 180mm and brown 135mm A beautiful stainless steal which combines two forging techniques. First one, called tsuchime, gives the blade a rough, hammered aspect. The second once, inspired by ancestral Middle East techniques (Damascus steel) is all about folding different lays of steel, depending on carbon level, creating beautiful watering pattern. This blade consists in 17 layers folded. This last technique allows maker to sign their work with particular pattern. The wooden handle is made of japanese white birch, that are reinforced with three nails. - Black 135mm Contrary to the two previous one, the blade of the black one is composed of 73 layers of stainless steel, wich forms watering patterns on the whole surface of the blade. Handle is in wood, ebony color, reinforced with 3 nails too. Maintenance and advices :- Always use the knives with a wooden cutting board. - After using, always wash and dry the knives with a soft wiping cloth. Never use the scratchy edge of a sponge. - Store your knife in a dry and ventilated space. - Japanese knives are not dishwasher safe. - Do not cut meat of fish bones. Sharpening : you may need to sharpen your knife to have a long-lasting sharpness. The best way is to use a whet stone if you have one or a mechanical sharpener. You can also ask a professionnal to sharpen your knife, for less than $10 per blade. Made in Japan in K00f4chi prefecture.

fields.description: The Bento&Co Sando Kit is an ideal kit to make cute and tasty sandwiches for your bento and carry them with style !Presentation Say goodbye to sad and boring sandwiches because you'll become a real professionnal of kawaii sandwiches thanks to this kit. The Bento&Co Sando Kit consists of:-  a Panda Sando Maru (yellow) : this is a two-part sandwich maker/cutter. To use, make a sandwich with two pieces of soft bread, making sure the filling is in the middle and doesn't extend all the way to the edges of the bread. Put the sandwich in between the two parts, and press hard. You'll get a sandwich that is sealed all around the edges, which can be eaten as-is or lightly toasted in a toaster oven. (You can also try toasting the bread before cutting it if you don't have a toaster oven.) You can also try folding a single slice of bread in half and sealing the edges. This tools comes with a small recipes book, where you can have ideas what you can do with the left edges. - a Sando stamp kit : these cutters will not only cut out shapes (a star, a flower and a round) from bread, ham, cheese, cooked vegetables and so on, the top parts will also stamp your bread to customize it. - and a Sando box : a matching sandwich case with blue bottom part and a white clip-on lid printed with a panda motif, for carrying your pocket sandwich. By the way, Panda is a pun in Japanese, since the word for bread is 'pan' - so 'pan-da' means 'it's bread'! And sando is Japanese for 'sandwich'. Tip: To help the bread edges seal, put the sandwich bread in a plastic bag and microwave on high for a few seconds, to make it slightly moist. Features Dimensions: The carrying case is 100 00d7 100 00d7 38 mm (3.9 x 3.9 x 1.5) and can hold 1 to 2 small sandwiches. fields.description: Komamonyo is a very special box. Made of turned and lacquered real wood (not a plastic imitation!), this is a gorgeous work of art. Use this as a bento box or a bonbon container, or even to hold paper clips...or just to place on your desk or table and admire. Presentation Komamonyo is created using traditional methods in Ishikawa prefecture, Japan. Each box requires several very skilled artisans to complete. A solid piece of tochi wood (a hardwood similar to chestnut) is hollowed out, then turned on lathes to be smooth inside and grooved outside. The pieces are then hand lacquered in multiple colors. The colors on the outside of red, green yellow and cream are vibrant yet somehow very natural. This box will go well with many styles of decor, both traditional and modern, so leave it out between uses as a bento box! Not only is this box beautiful, it has a practical advantage over plastic boxes too. Steamed rice stored inside wooden bento boxes tends to 'breathe', so that it doesn't get soggy. This means that the rice tastes much better. Koma means 'spinning top' in Japanese. Komamonyo is made to look like a spinning top, a traditional child's toy that was very popular in the middle Edo period (around the 18th-19th centuries). Bright red objects are supposed to protect the owner from bad luck and illness. So who knows...maybe this bento box will keep you healthy and happy? FeaturesThis is a two tier box. Each tier or compartment is made out of a single piece of wood, as is the lid. The tiers stack securely. Dimensions: 13.5cm in diameter x 12.5cm high (5.31 diameter x 4.92 high). We recommend using a furoshiki wrapping cloth to wrap and carry this box. The box comes packaged in a beautiful handmade washi paper-look box.Composition and care Made of tochi wood, a hardwood similar to chestnut. Lacquered inside and out (the colors are derived from natural lacquer sap). Note that there may be slight variations in the wood pattern, since no two pieces are alike. Hand wash only. Don't let this near a microwave, oven, open flame or dishwasher! Use warm water and a mild dishwashing detergent if necessary; rinse well and wipe with a soft cloth. With proper care, this box will become a family heirloom. Made in Japan.
fields.name: Komamonyo

fields.description: Kuma and messages cutters is a food-cutters kit to decorate your bento in only few minutes. It also includes a pair of tweezers and a plastic pin, to aid you in placing the tiny cut-out shapes in your creative bentos.The kuma cutter is about 6cm long (2.36)TipsThese cutters work best with cooked food, such as ham, cooked egg, and boiled or steamed vegetable slices. You can also use them on fruit.  They work best with food that's at least 3mm (1/10th of an inch) thick, and a bit flexible. Do not try to cut nori seaweed with this - you'll just get frustrated!Made in plastic PETMade in China.

fields.description: Perhaps this box looks familiar? We love the Kyo Bento Box so much that we actually decided to make it part of our site logo! Although we carry many beautiful boxes, it's safe to say that this is our favorite of them all. This is a genuine wood (not a plastic imitation!) bento box with a warm, natural feel. Size M.Presentation  The Kyo Bento Box is a two-tier,  traditional wooden bento box, made of wood from the harigiri (kaloponax) tree called sen. The slightly open grain of the wood and the warm reddish-brown color adds to its natural charm. The box is hand made by a skilled artisan in Aizu Wakamatsu, Fukushima prefecture, an area known for wooden boxes. The box is finished with food grade polyurethane to show off the wood to its best advantage. The classic oval shape is called koban, after the similarly shaped coins that used to be in circulation in Japan.This box is a pleasure to hold in your hands while you eat! This product is made of wood cut long before the 11 March 2011, in an area far from the Fukushima nuclear plant. This product and others from this maker are absolutely not dangerous. Safety is our first concern, and we continue to support these artisans in this difficult time.Features Total capacity: 700ml (350ml per tier). There is a matching wooden lid, and one T-shaped internal wooden divider. Dimensions: 15cm long x 10.5cm wide x 8cm high (4.92 x 4.13 x 3.14). We recommend using a furoshiki wrapping cloth for wrapping and transporting this bento box. Packaged in a beautiful presentation box. Composition and care 100% wood, with a food grade polyurethane finish. Not microwave, oven or dishwasher safe! Hand wash only using cold or lukewarm water and a mild dishwashing detergent if needed. Dry with a soft cloth. Do not leave soaking in water. Oils that may leech from your food just deepen the color of the wood. With proper care, this  box is sure to become a treasured family heirloom. Made in Fukushima, Japan.
