fields.description: With the Let's Sando mold, it's just so easy to make cute bear-shaped pocket sandwiches that fit in your bento.Pocket sandwich is basically two pieces of sandwich bread that are cut and sealed on the edges, with filling inside. Pocket sandwiches are cute and easy to eat, especially for small children. They are very popular in Japan, and are sold at supermarkets and convenience stores (konbini). How to use it :1) Lightly toast two pieces of sandwich bread (you can also microwave them for easy cutting).2) Put the filling in the middle and try not to extend all the way to the edges of the bread. 3) Press hard the two pieces with the Let's Sando mold. Gently take off the mold, you'll get a sandwich that is sealed all around the edges. 4) It's ready, let's eat (or put it in your bento) !5) Don't throw the crusts out ! You can make some french toasts with an egg, or breadcrumb for tempuras...Molds measurements : about 9,5cm in diameter (3.7) and 3cm thick (1.2). Made in polypropylene. Made in Japan.

fields.description: Magewappa Classic is a classic, genuine Otade Magewappa bento box, made of sugi or Japanese cedar wood. Bento&co is proud to offer this traditionally crafted item to you direct from Japan. Size M. Presentation Magewappa means 'bent wood' in Japanese. It's a traditional form of woodcraft that is found in Odate, in the northern Akita prefecture. It is an officially designated Traditional Craft form in Japan. It used to be encouraged as winter work for farmers and lower-class samurai by the lord of the area. Magewappa Classic is a classic one-tier, oval shaped box with a matching fitted lid. The blonde bent wood sides, made from straight grain wood, are fastened with small strips of darker wood by highly skilled artisans using traditional methods. A matching wooden separator is included.As with all real magewappa ware, the wood is uncoated, which allows rice packed inside to breathe, making it taste great even when cold. The wood also smells wonderful, since it is cedar! Somehow the cedar aroma seems to enhance the flavor of your food. Magewappa Classic is a great everyday bento box that will bring a smile to your face every time you use it. Features Magewappa Classic is a single tier, oval shaped bento box. It measures  19 cm x 12 cm x 6 cm high (7,5 x 4.7 x 2,4) and has an inner capacity of approximately 640ml. The Bento&co logo is burned into the inside of the lid - we're proud to have our mark on such a high quality product.Note that this is a genuine Otade Magewappa box, made to the highest standards. You'll notice the difference immediately from inferior versions sold by other companies, when you touch the silky smooth surface and see the workmanship. Composition and careMade from sustainably farmed sugi (Japanese cedar) wood. Since the wood is untreated, some care should be taken with this box: - Wash in lukewarm water. Do not use dishwasher detergent unless absolutely necessary. We recommend packing food that may stain the wood in a separate container, or in bento cups. Use a gentle sponge, nothing abrasive. - Do not leave immersed in water. - After washing, wipe off any excess water with a soft cloth, then leave the box open to dry completely. Replace the lid only after it has completely dried out, after a day or so. With proper care, this box will last for many years. Made in Japan, in Otade, Akita prefecture.
fields.name: Magewappa Classic

fields.description: Let's be serious for a while, have you ever succeed in putting cellophane on you leftovers in just one go ?  The New Krewrap (in japanese, say kurey wrap !), is going to change your life ! This well-recognized household wrapping film in Japan is a little revolution in its field. This is the first food wrap film launched in Japan so that Mr and Mrs Tanaka could wrap any remaining food. It became one of the must-have tool in every japanese kitchen. Here on Bento&Co, you can buy 2 different New Krewrap : the 22cm (8.6) long one, or the 15cm (5.9) long one. The New Krewrap is available singly, as a set of 2 which is cheaper. Please choose from the pulldown menu when ordering.You must probably wonder why we offer japanese plastic film although you have everything you need in your local grocery ? Here are 5 good reasons that should convince you to pick them up :  1) Japanese expatriates are positive  : in France, in the US, in Germany, in England, or anywhere else, food wrap film is too easily torn up, curled up and shriveled up, well just not practical.  2) Withstands temperature is between -6000b0C and 14000b0C (-7600b0F and 28400b0F) so it's freezer and microwave safe !  3) The two widths available (22 cm and 15cm) are much more likable than the 30cm long one you can find everywhere. Use it for a bowl, a piece of lemon, your kid's unfinished yoghurt or of course, your bento box.  4) Because the easy opening is really easy, and the cutting edge allows precise and neat cutting. (see the video bellow) 5) Because it won several honored prizes such as Good Design Award in Japan, DFA in Germany, and even adopted in Poland. (see the video bellow)Product made in Japan.Do not put the plastic film in an oven or near an open flame.  Be careful with very fat ingredient. While microwaving, oil can heat and distort the cellophane.

fields.description: We know you fancy beautiful japanese products, that's why you're here, aren't you ? Let's discover this Ohitsu set, a gorgeous japanese tub for rice and sushi.Ohitsu set consists in a steamed-rice tub of 24 cm in diameter (9.4) and 7,5 cm high (2.9), ohitsu or handai, a matching lid and a cha-moji, the traditional wooden spoon for rice, 18cm long (7). Traditionally, rice would be transferred from a cooker to an Ohitsu to keep rice warm at the table. Today, Ohitsu tubs are mainly used to prepare sushi rice (mixing it with rice vinegar) or to prepare a chirashi sushi (or scattered sushi). The advantage of using a wooden Ohistu is that the untreated wood absorbs excess moisture from the rice.Made of japanese cypress wood, called Hinoki, this wood's nice smell matches perfectly with rice.  You can also use this tub for other purposes : a famous 3 stars restaurant in Roanne, France, uses it as a bread basket...A little about hinoki woodHinoki is a type of Japanese cedar wood. It is known to have natural antimicrobial qualities. It also absorbs excess moisture from food, making it taste better. Hinoki is used extensively for food containers, bento boxes (see our Magewappa bento boxes), and even traditional bathtubs. Hand wash only. Do not leave the plank soaking in water for too long. Wipe with a soft dry cloth after washing. Please don't use this as a cutting board for your bread, or you will damage the surface!Made in Japan, in Mie prefecture.

fields.description: Onigiri Push gives you a choice between 3 push molds for forming onigiri, or Japanese rice balls, with ease! The shapes are a star, a heart, and a bear face - perfect for charaben. - Onigiri Push Tawara: Make up to 3 cylinder-shaped onigiri or sushi rice balls at once. The perforated surfaces of the molds allows air to circulate, so that the rice is released easily. To use an Onigiri Push Mold, wet both parts with water and shake off any excess moisture. Fill the deep cups with warm rice up to the brim, then push down with the shallow cups or lid. Take the lid off, and push the onigiri out of the mold from the other side. fields.description: The Original Magewappa is a chic, traditional Japanese bento box that has been handcrafted out of Japanese cedar. These works of art have been commissioned by Bento&Co and so you cannot find them anywhere else. We are very proud of this original product, and we want to help support and promote the amazing crafts people that create these products. Size: MMagewappa means 'bent wood' in Japanese. It's a traditional form of woodcraft that is found in Odate, in the northern Akita prefecture. It is an officially designated Traditional Craft form in Japan. It used to be encouraged as winter work for farmers and lower-class samurai by the lord of the area. The Original Magewappa is a classic one-tier, oval shaped box with a matching flat fitted lid.  The blonde bent wood sides, made from straight grain wood, are fastened with small strips of darker wood by highly skilled artisans using traditional methods. A matching wooden separator is included. The inside of the lid is with a branded Bento&Co, showing that it is one of a kind. It is best used with a furoshiki, wrapping cloth to keep the lid on and keep it clean. As with all real magewappa ware, the wood is uncoated, which allows rice packed inside to breathe, making it taste great even when cold. It's beauty will bring a smile to your face every time you use it. CharacteristicsThe Original Magewappa is a single tier, oval shaped bento box. It measures 55 mm x 200 mm x 95 mm (HxLxW) (2.2 x 7.8 x 3.7) and has an inner capacity of approximately 600ml. The Bento&co logo is burned into the inside of the lid - we're proud to have our mark on such a high quality product.Note that this is a genuine Otade Magewappa box, made to the highest standards. You'll notice the difference immediately from inferior versions sold by other companies, when you touch the silky smooth surface and see the workmanship. Composition and careMade from sustainably farmed Japanese cedar (sugi, ?) wood. Since the wood is untreated, some care should be taken with this box: - Wash in lukewarm water. Do not use dishwasher detergent unless absolutely necessary. We recommend packing food that may stain the wood in a separate container, or in bento cups. Use a gentle sponge, nothing abrasive. - Do not leave immersed in water. - After washing, wipe off any excess water with a soft cloth, then leave the box open to dry completely. fields.description: The Panda Sando set not only lets you create pocket sandwiches with ease, it transports them with style! Presentation What is a pocket sandwich? It's basically two pieces of sandwich bread that are cut and sealed on the edges, with filling inside. Pocket sandwiches are cute and easy to eat, especially for small children. They are very popular in Japan, and are sold at supermarkets and convenience stores (konbini). The set consists of:-  a two-part sandwich maker/cutter. To use, make a sandwich with two pieces of soft bread, making sure the filling is in the middle and doesn't extend all the way to the edges of the bread. Put the sandwich in between the two parts, and press hard. You'll get a sandwich that is sealed all around the edges, which can be eaten as-is or lightly toasted in a toaster oven. (You can also try toasting the bread before cutting it if you don't have a toaster oven.) You can also try folding a single slice of bread in half and sealing the edges. - a matching sandwich case with a peanut-butter brown bottom part and a white clip-on lid printed with a panda motif, for carrying your pocket sandwich. You can also get a spare case in Blue or Pink here!By the way, Panda is a pun in Japanese, since the word for bread is 'pan' - so 'pan-da' means 'it's bread'! And sando is Japanese for 'sandwich'. There are clear illustrative step-by-step photos on the box. Tip: To help the bread edges seal, put the sandwich bread in a plastic bag and microwave on high for a few seconds, to make it slightly moist. FeaturesDimensions: The carrying case is 100 00d7 100 00d7 38 mm (3.9 x 3.9 x 1.5) and can hold 1 to 2 small sandwiches. fields.description: The Shiroki box is a truly exceptional large box. Handcrafted out of untreated pale wood (shiroki), it is a work of the finest Japanese craftmanship. Size XL.In Japan, this type of square, stacking box is used during the New Year holiday season, for presenting osechi - a selection of carefully prepared delicacies, each with some lucky significance. (Wikipedia.) It can also be used for presenting sushi at a party, or anything that strikes your imagination. The Shiroki box is so special, you may want to just have it out on display all the time. It is created by skilled artisans in Yamanaka, a town in Ishikawa prefecture has been renowned for its fine lacquerware for 450 years, using methods that were developed during the Edo period. The Shiroki box is made up of two layers. It is made from two types of straight grain wood: Tama (a type of Japanese cedar) and Nara (another type of Japanese wood). The corners of the two layers are precisely dovetailed. The inside is hand finished in bright red natural lacquer, which not only protects the wood from food placed within, but also provides a discreet flash of color that is only visible when the box is opened. This is a very Japanese kind of aesthetic. Dimensions: 19 cm (7.48) square and 13 cm (5.12) high. Packaged in a beautiful presentation box, this would make a very special gift for a lucky person. Compostion and care Before you use this for the first time, rinse carefully in lukewarm water, and dry immediately with a very soft cloth. Only wash this is in plain water. Do not use dishwashing detergent. Always dry immediately after washing with a soft cloth. Do not leave immersed in water. Lacquerware has a certain odor when it is brand new. This will dissipate with time. Place Natsume Kuro in an airy location to make the odor fade faster. Keep all fine lacquerware out of direct sunlight. With proper care, Shiroki will become a treasured family hierloom, to pass down through the generations. Handcrafted in Japan. The wood and lacquer are both from Japanese sources.

fields.description:
Samsung Bluetooth Mono and Stereo Headset Modus BH6450, BHM6450NMACSTA in Blue. Earbud Style Bluetooth with attachable Premium Stereo Earbuds and Optional Ear Hook (Included).



Premium Dual Use Bluetooth Headset:
Samsung Modus BH6450 Bluetooth. Use as a Conventional In-Ear Headset or Attach Included Premium Stereo Earbuds for Rich Stereo Sound (Stereo Sound ONLY available on Phones with the A2DP or AVRC Profile).


Overview:
The elegant new, next-generation Modus 6450 wraps the best in functionality, fun and fashion in a sleek crystal-blue form factor. The Modus is designed for consumers looking for a conventional noise-cancelling Bluetooth headset with the capability to stream stereo audio. It can be worn as a mono-style headset for placing and receiving calls and readily transforms into a stereo Bluetooth headset when connected to the included stereo ear bud headset for an enhanced audio experience.


New and Improved:
The 6450 improves on its predecessor, the HM3500, with a premium headphone set, voice command functionality, and EQ settings. Rather than just simple voice prompts, the Modus 6450 implements voice commands and EQ settings through a separate Voice Command Button on the headset, distinguishing it from most competitors that must use a multifunction button for voice command start.


Features:
The Modus 6450 is compatible with its own specially-designed Android application, the Samsung Bluetooth FreeSync ??equipped with several features that set it apart from other applications, including EQ settings for stereo mode, LED settings, and language selection. The FreeSync application allows for text-to-speech messaging and caller ID services and the ability to enable or disable Bluetooth headset functions through the application. Via the FreeSync application, owners of the Modus 6450 can receive incoming phone calls, SMS messages and email. Features appointment notifications through a friendly text to speech interface that personally reads information to you. Also has voice command, pairing assist, multiple language support and hands-free control of various headset and stereo EQ settings.


Battery Life:
Talk and/or Play time of up to 6 hours and standby time of up to 180 hours.

Bluetooth Hands-free profile(HF), Headset profile(HSP), A2DP and AVRC are supported on this Bluetooth version 2.1 + EDR, class 2 device for fast, secure connectivity up to 30 feet away.


Click here to determine if your cell phone model is Bluetooth enabled, AND which Bluetooth profiles it can support.


Genuine Samsung Factory original one year warranty.

fields.description:
Enter a new level of realism and entertainment with the Samsung UN55ES6600 3D LED LCD TV.

The Samsung UN55ES6600 features Active Shutter technology, the industry's most advanced 3D solution to produce captivating, touchable 3D effect in Full HD, which is as close as you can get to the real thing. The Smart Content with signature service brings you to a new world full of enjoyment. The cutting-edge apps connect you to family and friends, help you maintain a healthy lifestyle and make learning fun for kids. A Full Web Browser with WiFi built-in lets you search the web and access your wireless network. Also use AllShare Play to view content from multiple devices on the big screen.

  • Samsung Smart TV Experience the Future of Smart TV Now. The Samsung Smart TV revolutionizes the way you use and watch your TV. Connect to Smart Content and find more to be entertained. New Signature Services helps you stay connected to more entertaining experiences for everyone: Family, Fitness and Kids. Discover even more possibilities with full web browser, plus "search" for content across all connected services. Watch, play and explore with a wide variety of Samsung Apps built for your TV.
  • Captivating 2D & 3D in Full HD 1080p Whether you2019re watching in 2D or 3D, Samsung Full HD 1080p displays picture quality that2019s crisp, clear, and breathtakingly life-like. It2019s as close as you can get to the real thing. Put on the 3D glasses to immerse yourself in the picture 2014 Samsung only uses Active shutter technology, which provides the experience of 3D in Full HD 1080p (when coupled with a 3D source such as a Samsung 3D Blu-ray player or a Full HD broadcast from satellite or cable providers). You can also convert 2D viewing to 3D, so you can watch sports, TV shows, and all your favorite programming in immersive 3D.
  • Clear Motion Rate of 600 Experience sharp picture quality, even when you are watching fast-moving images like sports or action movies. Clear Motion Rate was developed to accurately measure how well a LCD or LED TV can depict fast-moving images. Previously, motion-clarity was calculated by the frame refresh rate alone. But CMR offers a more complete measure by calculating 3 factors: frame refresh rate, image processor speed and backlight technology. A CMR of 600 pushes motion-clarity to advanced levels of breathtaking quality. LEDs TVs with this CMR can display action-packed movement with ultra-sharp detail and the deepest levels of black and white for a superior contrast.
  • Eco Sensor & Wide Color Enhancer Plus The unique Eco light sensor measures the intensity of the room's light and automatically calibrates the brightness of the image on the screen. In a sun- filled environment, the screen gets brighter and in dim surroundings, the intensity is reduced. This feature optimizes the viewing experience while also saving you energy. Wide Color Enhancer Plus allows you to see picture color the way the director originally intended. Witness the entire RGB spectrum brought to life on your screen to bring you exceptionally vibrant, yet natural-looking images faithful to the director's original intent.
  • AllShare Play & Built-In Wi-Fi Enjoy your favorite digital content from any of your DLNA-connected Samsung Devices. Whether it2019s your music library on your PC, videos on your Smart TV, or photos on your Smart phone 2014 AllShare Play lets you wirelessly access and share that content between your Samsung devices regardless of where you are. And there2019s no need for any cables or connecting devices. AllShare Play is also equipped with Cloud technology, so you can upload your favorite content to a central web storage account and access it wherever you are. With built-in WiFi, no additional equipment is needed to connect with an existing wireless router in your home network and start accessing Samsung Apps or other Smart TV features.
  • Anynet+ (HDMI-CEC) With Samsung's Anynet+ you'll enjoy one-touch control for all your Samsung HDMI-connected compatible devices like your Samsung TV, Blu-ray Disc player, AV Receiver and Home Theater

fields.description:
The Samsung WB30F Smart Digital Camera is a point-and-shoot with a 16.2MP CCD image sensor. It's equipped with a large 3" LCD screen with a 230K-dot resolution. Its 10x optical zoom lens has an effective focal length of 4.3-43mm, equivalent to 24-240mm in 35mm format. Capture HD 720p video at 30fps.

Capture sweeping pan shots with 2D Panorama. Smart Auto takes the calculating and guesswork out of photography by automatically selecting the best settings for a given scene. The WB30F also features a Smart Movie mode. Face, Blink and Smile Detection help you snap photos of people at just the right moments. Other available shooting modes include Program, Scene, Photo Filter, Split Shot, Motion Photo, Close Up, Magic Frame, Live Panorama, Beauty Shot and Night Shot.

Smart Camera features include Wi-Fi and email, as well as a Direct LINK hot key to help you quickly connect to Wi-Fi networks. Download the Samsung Smart Camera App to get Mobile Link, Remote Viewfinder and AutoShare, rather than downloading each individually. Instead of launching the apps one at a time on your smartphone, you can open all three simultaneously with the touch of a finger.

Mobile Link lets you select and send an image or album directly to an Android smartphone, iPhone or tablet; you need not even send the image as a text message or as an email. Make updates to the album on your phone and the changes will be saved to your camera, too.

The Remote Viewfinder function enables you to control your camera by using your smartphone as the viewfinder (available for select smartphones). You can preview images, adjust camera settings, zoom in and out and frame each scene. AutoShare allows you to simultaneously send every picture you take to your mobile phone via Wi-Fi. Just set it up once and the camera saves it as the default setting. AutoShare also GPS tags your photos with your smartphone.

fields.description: Documentary filmmaker Jeff Reichert ponders the troubling prospect that elections in America are decided before the first vote is ever cast by examining how the framework of democracy provides politicians with an entirely legal means of controlling electoral outcomes. The MERRIAM-WEBSTER DICTIONARY definition of "gerrymandering" reads: "to divide a territorial unit into election districts to give one political party an electoral majority in a large number of districts while concentrating the voting strength of the opposition in as few districts as possible." As the debate surrounding the reliability of the electoral system rages, the question of how to ensure that the system is more accurate and accountable comes up time and again. Can that broken system ever be fixed? By posing that question, among many others, to governors, state representatives, Supreme Court justices, political strategists, party chairmen, scholars, and journalists, Reichert proposes that the fundamental democratic premise that voters actually choose their elected representative may be a falsehood implemented to create the illusion of democracy.
fields.name: Gerrymandering

Super Contrast Panel

Larger Red/Green/Blue sub-pixel color areas within the panel create a picture that rivals LED TVs for brightness.
